description: This Java source file contains integration tests for handling staff images using the Fineract API client. It defines a test class 'FeignImageTest' which creates a staff member, uploads an image, retrieves it, updates it, and finally deletes it, verifying each operation's response.

classes.name: FeignImageTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing staff image upload, retrieval, update, and deletion via the Fineract API client.

methods.name: setupStaff
methods.description: Creates a staff member with specified details to be used in subsequent image operations.

methods.name: testCreateStaffImage
methods.description: Uploads an image for the staff member and verifies the response.

methods.name: testRetrieveStaffImage
methods.description: Retrieves the previously uploaded staff image and verifies the response content.

methods.name: testUpdateStaffImage
methods.description: Updates the staff image and verifies the response.

methods.name: testDeleteStaffImage
methods.description: Deletes the staff image and verifies the response.
